title: Snuggnose rises up with hip-hop anthem "Come from Nothing"
htmlContent: Indianapolis rapper Snuggnose hits the ground running with his latest release, "Come from Nothing." This is a song rooted in brutal honesty and unrelenting resolve, about overcoming the odds and reaching for the impossible. Influenced by the likes of Lil Baby, Dr. Dre, Snoop Dogg, and Nipsey Hussle, Snuggnose employs that storytelling with some signature grit all his own. The track takes it head-on, turning struggle into motivation and pain into purpose. https://open.spotify.com/track/33SaXvBMrDazahsY05Ezad "Come from Nothing" is meant to inspire those who are still grinding, still pushing, and still dreaming. What he has created is a piece of music about his truth, but which also opens up space for others to find their own. It's evidence once again that the ascent out of nothingness can kindle a voice so forceful it might pull others behind it, along for the ride. This is the kind of track that makes Snuggnose an artist to watch, one who can bring openness, as well as a hard edge, to the mic. On "Come from Nothing," he proves that hip hop is a lifeline, carrying narratives of resilience to anyone willing to listen. Follow Snuggnose on Instagram
